## Purpose and scope

What argument, example, source interpretation, or mechanism changes?

## Evidence status

Distinguish source-backed descriptions, proposals, synthetic examples, and observations. Link primary evidence or a reproducible result. State missing evidence.

## Checks

Record actual local commands and results. Confirm internal links, generated diagrams/reader, and example tests remain consistent. Identify checks not run.

## Consequences and rights

Does this change an agreed decision, attribution, license, or authority boundary? Confirm that no secrets, identifiable client information, or unlicensed source copies are added.
